Senses.Explanation: You have opened my clouds of delusion and let me enter — the outsider's praise of the long silence, quoted whole by six centuries of raisers who then refuse to let either the silence or the praise rest. The case, as raised by Chushi Fanqi in his raising-old section: an outsider asked the Buddha — I ask not of words, not of wordlessness. The World-Honored One held a long silence. The outsider praised: great mercy — you have opened my clouds of delusion and let me enter. After he left, Ananda asked what the outsider had attained that he spoke of entry; the Buddha: like a fine horse of this world, it moves at the shadow of the whip. Xuedou Chongxian: right and wrong undivided — the fault lies with the whip-shadow. Dahui Zonggao: right and wrong both divided — rightly by the whip-shadow. Chushi: want to see the undivided? Who is the outsider, who is the World-Honored One? Want to see them divided? The One is the One, the outsider the outsider. This is Tianning's seeing — let the four directions disparage it as they will. And Miyun Yuanwu, probing the old in his own record, reads the variant closely: the World-Honored One sat fast — the outsider never sat fast. Where, then, is the outsider's place of entry? Tianyin Yuanxiu lifts the exchange with both elders' comments already inside it, then turns: the two great elders judge exactly inside the whip-shadow — tell me, one phrase apart from the whip-shadow: how is it said? A long silence: thirty years from now, these words will run everywhere. And Feiyin Tongrong's picking: the World-Honored One's long silence filled the ditches and plugged the ravines; the outsider got in — an old scar meeting moxa. Inspect it closely and each gets a pair of straw sandals: he only wants everyone under heaven to doubt. If today someone asked this mountain monk — not of words, not of wordlessness — I would just raise one finger. Same as the World-Honored One, or different? Yichu Wuyuan, showing the assembly: a fine World-Honored One — cracked by the outsider. The outsider, clever as he is, will enter hell like an arrow. And Ananda's white report to the Buddha — the whole assembly hotly deceived by the One. What does this mountain monk make of it? One crack of the staff: who knew that beyond the far mist-waves there is still good consulting to be had. And Tian'an Sheng, holding the whisk for the head seat: I have sixty staffs, split in three shares — one share beats the outsider, for letting himself be deceived plain and white; one share beats the World-Honored One, for handing out winter-melon seals so easily; one share Sheng the seat-holder eats himself, for inspecting the buddhas and the patriarchs. As for Ananda — let him go stand at the One's right hand.
